name: Futaba
source:
Saddled with the unpleasantly demanding duty of serving as [url=https://vndb.org/c1786]Hanabi[/url]'s butler, this little cat-boy would evoke a lot of pity. After all, he must be at her service every hour of every day. However, it turns out that he actually enjoys it a little bit too much. He also has a fiancée that is waiting for him in Cat Kingdom.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/919344-lets-meow-meow/faqs/35340]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
